title: Render data as a native table from declarative column definitions
problem: A table built from generic elements looks like a table and is not one. Assistive technology cannot announce which header a cell belongs to, and a component that writes cell values as markup turns any data it displays into something that can execute.
context: This is the first task of a learner-authored forge project. No source exists yet. The learner creates the repository, chooses its structure, and owns every design decision inside the specification's constraints.
impact: Every later feature, sorting, filtering and performance work included, is built on this structure. If the structure is wrong, every later feature is inaccessible no matter how well it works.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Columns are described by data (a field or accessor, a header label, and an optional formatter). Adding a column requires no change to the component.
The output is a native table with a caption, th header cells with an explicit scope, and one row element per data row.
Every cell value is rendered as text. A value containing markup is displayed literally.
A row that lacks a column's field renders an explicit empty value and does not throw.
Automated tests cover the rendered structure, a markup-bearing value, and a missing field, and pass at the submitted revision.
The learner explains the column definition shape, one rejected alternative, and what an assistive technology user loses if the header scope is omitted.

constraints: The component itself uses no runtime dependencies. TypeScript, a test runner and a DOM implementation for tests are the only development dependencies.
Do not implement sorting, filtering or asynchronous loading yet. This task ends at a correct static render.
Do not push to a remote or open a pull request as part of this task.

scope.description: One render function and its public column definition shape.

investigation_areas: Which native table elements and attributes carry meaning to assistive technology, and which are presentational
How a DOM API choice decides whether a value is interpreted as markup
What the smallest column definition is that a caller can extend without a component change
testing_expectations: Run the project's own test suite. State the exact command in the design.
documentation_requirements: Record the column definition shape and the rejected alternative in the learner design.
